verdict.rationale: Leaving is the better-supported half of this story. The SDK is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs, and lets you mix providers per agent (gh-1, docs-38). Exporting data is only implied: conversation history can be pulled out via `.to_input_list()` and sessions (docs-8), and tracing to OpenAI's hosted dashboard can be turned off (docs-40, docs-18). Missing for 10: any documented export of sessions, traces or other stored data in open formats; export from the hosted Traces dashboard; independent corroboration of data portability.
